summary: Detrended Price Oscillator: price minus a shifted 21-bar average, to show short cycles without the trend.
overview: The Detrended Price Oscillator (DPO) removes the longer trend so you can see shorter cycles. It plots in its own pane around zero, green above and red below.
With Centered on, the line is shifted back so it lines up with the prices it measures.
how: DPO = source - SMA(source, 21) taken from 21 / 2 + 1 bars earlier. In centered mode the line is moved back by that many bars, so the newest bars show no value.
It compares price with an older value of the average, not the current one.
use: Use peaks and troughs to estimate the length of recent cycles.
Some traders watch zero crossings to time swings inside a range.
Use the centered view to study past cycles, and the default view for the latest bars.
Compare cycle highs with price highs.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It is not built to show trend direction.
